name: 韭研公社账号时间线
description: 抓取韭研公社作者主页的最新文章，返回指定条数（默认 15，最多 100；滚动加载）。需要微信登录态。

inputs.name: uid
inputs.description: 作者主页路径 /u/<hash> 中的 hash（在文章页点作者名可得）

body.name: js

args.expression: (async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500));const want=(p)=>{p=(p||'').trim();return (!p||p[0]==='$')?'':p;};const lim=Math.max(1,Math.min(Number(want('$limit'))||15,100));const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const extract=()=>{const seen=new Set();const posts=[];for(const a of document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/a/"]')){const href=a.getAttribute('href')||'';const url=location.origin+href;if(seen.has(url))continue;const t=(a.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();if(t.length>3){seen.add(url);posts.push({title:t.slice(0,120),url:url});}}return posts;};let posts=extract();for(let i=0;i<15&&posts.length<lim;i++){const before=posts.length;window.scrollTo(0,document.body.scrollHeight);await sleep(900+Math.floor(Math.random()*400));posts=extract();if(posts.length>=lim)break;if(posts.length===before&&i>1)break;}window.scrollTo(0,0);await sleep(300);return {ok:true,count:posts.length,posts:posts.slice(0,lim),loaded:posts.length};})()

body.note: 滚动触发懒加载后抓取文章流
